summary.conclusion: Large useful visual improvement over enlarged raw256 faces. Ten reasonable whole-portrait research candidates under a practical photographic threshold, with caveats recorded. This is synthesized detail, not recovered truth or proof of novel identities. Face restoration does not repair background geometry or broken garments; it may change apparent age, mouth shape and expression. No obvious new catastrophic anatomy defects identified in this half, but smoothing and unusually uniform texture recur.
